headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Maintains Overweight on Welltower, Raises Price Target to $260
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald  analyst Richard Anderson   maintains Welltower (NYSE:WELL) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $235 to $260.
